id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description:
The user visible name of this {@link ReliabilityMetric}. This must be unique among all reliability metrics shown
to the user and must use just valid characters (This includes alphanumeric characters and underscore). See
{@link #isNameDuplicated} for more information.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

dependencyMetrics.description:
A list of dependency metrics. This is needed, so when a deletion happens,
the user is alerted that the following chained metrics will be deleted as well.
Will be fetched from the {@link ReliabilityMetricDependencies} based on the `relationType`.

childMetrics.description:
A list of child metrics. This is needed, so when a user tries to promote a metric to Shared/Public,
the user is alerted that the following chained metrics will be promoted to Shared/Public as well.
Will be fetched from the {@link ReliabilityMetricDependencies} based on the `relationType`.

description.description:
The detailed description of how to uses the metric. This is how the
user understands which arguements can be placed within the call.

allowedUser.description:
The name of the user who created this metric and imposed a restriction
so that only they can view it. If this field is blank, all can view the
custom created metric.

assets.description: A list of related assets that this metric is associated with.

permission.description:
If the #allowedUser field is populated, then we assume this is a private
created record.

expression.description: The expression of the metric, which is shown and defined by the user.

expandedExpression.description: The expanded expression of the metric, which is used for metric calculations.

facility.description: The {@link Facility} associated with this metric.

lastUpdated.description:
This is meant to represent the last user updated execution.
There will be backend jobs that run to update #dependencyMetrics
so you should never use meta data.

title: This type represents stored metric expressions defined by the user.
name: ReliabilityMetric
